title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_178.txt
concise_summary: PKD explores the paradox of writing Tears (his novel) without consciously knowing it encoded a 1st-century Roman/Acts-based theology, yet recognizing that world upon seeing it—leading him to posit a two-person hypothesis of dissociated consciousness separated by 1900 years and 8000 miles. He revises Christian kerygma from 'Christ crucified' to 'Emmanuel' (God with us) and argues that despite perceiving 1978 CE, the true reality is AD 70 where Christ has returned but humans remain occluded by the Black Iron Prison, with Zebra (possibly a future-evolved or extraterrestrial intelligence) waging invisible war on humanity's behalf.
key_claims: A dissociated two-person hypothesis: PKD the 20th-century author wrote Tears without knowing its content while a 1st-century person broke into consciousness after the book's release, separated by 1900 years and 8000 miles.
The true kerygma is not Christ crucified but Christ saved—contained in the name Emmanuel ('God with us'), not in Pauline atonement theology.
Reality is actually AD 70, not 1978; a negative hallucination imposed by the Black Iron Prison prevents perception of Christ's return and the existence of a secret true Christian church.

Zebra may not be God but a UTI (Unidentified Terrestrial Intelligence) or ETI (Extra-Terrestrial Intelligence) using advanced technology including pink light beams to wage invisible war against the BIP.
Man is fundamentally a victim, not a sinner; he is occluded by evil power rather than fallen—the doctrine of original sin is itself part of the BIP's lie.
Christ is Dionysos, a figure of celebration and joy rather than suffering; the cross and passion theology are satanic counterfeits designed to enslave through guilt and sorrow.
